forbiddenPatterns.pattern: Everything you run\. One clear view\.
(?:\bworks offline with private customer data\b|\bqueued offline writes?\b)
(?:\bpublic registration is (?:available|open)\b|\bno-card trial\b|\bFounder plan is available\b|\bStartup plan is available\b)

claims.claim: TREVV is currently a fictional-data technical preview.
claims.scope: Every hosted preview entry, legal notice, and product-evaluation surface.
claims.limitations: The undeployed live-mode runtime and local CI evidence do not make the hosted demo a production service.

claims.claim: Authenticated live-mode founder-loop changes are canonical and server-saved.
claims.scope: Authenticated DEMO_MODE=false engineering environments only.
claims.limitations: May not be generalized to hosted production availability, backup, privacy effects, integrations, billing, or every preview surface.

claims.claim: Email/password authentication, verification, recovery, and server sessions work in live mode.
claims.scope: Configured DEMO_MODE=false environments with PostgreSQL and mail delivery.
claims.limitations: No public production service, MFA, passkey, native-session, or staffed account-recovery promise is implied.

claims.claim: Teams and contextual Messages are durable and permissioned in live mode.
claims.scope: Configured live-mode Web/API/PostgreSQL/worker environments.
claims.limitations: This is not a Slack replacement, delivery-receipt service, presence system, file service, or end-to-end encrypted messenger.

claims.claim: No production provider integration is connected or enabled.
claims.scope: All preview integration, email, resource-link, and settings surfaces.
claims.limitations: Smart links, provider names, and picker seams are previews and must never be described as synchronization or revocation.

claims.claim: Billing, checkout, subscriptions, trials, invoices, and paid plans are not enabled.
claims.scope: Every pricing, account, signup, entitlement, and commercial surface.
claims.limitations: Prices in planning artifacts are experiments and must not appear as an offer.

claims.claim: Privacy and Terms are engineering previews pending qualified review.
claims.scope: Privacy, terms, signup, account privacy, and data-inventory surfaces.
claims.limitations: They are not a reviewed privacy notice, contract, DPA, compliance opinion, or completed data-lifecycle service.

claims.claim: TREVV is 99.9% available or backed by an active production SLO.
claims.scope: All public, contractual, sales, support, status, and product surfaces.
claims.limitations: Bounded local RUM ingestion exists, but no remote operating window, production collector, pager, staffed response, or error-budget evidence exists.

evidence.detail: Local RUM ingestion is not production SLO evidence.

claims.claim: TREVV is GDPR compliant, independently secure, penetration-tested, or certified.
claims.scope: All marketing, legal, security, procurement, sales, and product surfaces.
claims.limitations: Engineering controls are not legal compliance, certification, or an independent security opinion.

evidence.detail: Independent security and legal gates remain open.

claims.claim: The intended GA client scope is Web/PWA only.
claims.scope: Download, platform, compatibility, help, onboarding, and marketing surfaces.
claims.limitations: Native mobile and desktop are companion foundations and are not release artifacts.

claims.claim: The intended GA locale scope is English only.
claims.scope: Language, help, onboarding, legal, support, and marketing surfaces.
claims.limitations: German support must not be advertised until complete extraction, persistence, translation, and responsive QA pass.

claims.claim: Messages are end-to-end encrypted.
claims.scope: All collaboration, security, sales, and legal surfaces.
claims.limitations: No end-to-end encryption design or verification exists.

evidence.detail: Implemented collaboration boundary makes no E2EE claim.

claims.claim: AI autonomously runs a company or performs external actions.
claims.scope: All product, marketing, sales, pricing, automation, and integration surfaces.
claims.limitations: No model or automated external effect is enabled; deterministic controls retain authority.

evidence.detail: No AI acceptance or reversal evidence.

claims.claim: Everything you run. One clear view.
claims.scope: Future positioning research only; this phrase is absent from current public product surfaces.
claims.limitations: Removed from public metadata and authentication copy. It remains an unapproved governance draft requiring a supported-scope qualifier and usability/retention evidence before any future marketing use.

evidence.detail: Records the withdrawn phrase as an unapproved future positioning draft.

claims.claim: TREVV is a founder operating system.
claims.scope: Future category-positioning research only; this phrase is absent from current public product surfaces.
claims.limitations: Removed from public metadata, the PWA manifest, and authentication copy. It may be tested again only with a precise supported-workflow qualifier and customer evidence; it is not proof of full business-system coverage.

evidence.detail: Records the withdrawn category phrase as an unapproved future positioning draft.

claims.claim: The PWA works offline with private customer data and queued writes.
claims.scope: PWA, help, product, reliability, and marketing surfaces.
claims.limitations: Only safe immutable assets and a content-free fallback are cached; private app/API data are not an offline source of truth.

claims.claim: Public registration, a no-card trial, Founder plan, or Startup plan is available.
claims.scope: Registration, pricing, onboarding, billing, sales, and marketing surfaces.
claims.limitations: Production permits only closed or server-validated invite_only admission; public mode is rejected. No billing gate, plan approval, authorization to enable public registration, or trial lifecycle exists.

evidence.detail: Production rejects public registration and defaults live admission to invite_only.
Invite-only signup requires a matching valid unconsumed invitation in PostgreSQL.
Pricing direction has no approval evidence.

claims.claim: Portfolio loads in under two seconds at production reference volume.
claims.scope: Performance, sales, support, status, procurement, and marketing surfaces.
claims.limitations: Route/asset budgets, local RUM ingestion, and a PostgreSQL 100-Workspace/10,000-item search harness are configured and the budget gate has executed in GitHub Actions, but no representative mobile, Portfolio/browser reference-volume, or production result exists.

evidence.detail: Only directional local evidence is recorded.
Local database search reference-volume harness only.
Configured route and asset limits without production proof.
Configured local RUM ingestion without measured operating evidence.

claims.claim: Customer export, account deletion, retention enforcement, and provider revocation are complete.
claims.scope: Privacy, account, organization, legal, procurement, support, and marketing surfaces.
claims.limitations: Only durable review requests and cancellation exist; no lifecycle effect is implemented.

claims.claim: No production-critical demo fallback remains.
claims.scope: GA release manifest and production claims only.
claims.limitations: This can be approved only after release-artifact scans, production configuration checks, native exclusion, and remote smoke evidence pass.

evidence.detail: Demo/live boundary and remaining native fallback limitation.
Desktop foundation still substitutes demo Workspaces on API failure.
